content.comment_body: I'm developing a program for use with a [product_name] basis module and a [product_name] operator device. For reference, the basis module is [article_no] with firmware [version_no], and the operator device is [article_no] with firmware [version_no]. I'm trying to display alternative text using the ticker feature. Lowering the ticker interval works in simulation, but on actual hardware it remains fixed at 10 seconds, regardless of the setting. Any advice?

Looks like there might be a bug in the [product_name] operator device. I experience the same issue: changing the ticker time has no effect, it stays the same. However, the ticker setting works as expected on the basis module’s display.

I've reached the same conclusion as [user_name]. With another project, I used a [product_name] basis module featuring an integrated display—there, the ticker time changes properly, but on the operator device it’s stuck at 10 seconds. It seems I’ll need a separate message block for each screen instead of relying on the ticker. [company_name] should improve testing procedures before releasing products; issues like these have occurred before with this hardware.

As a trial, I experimented using the web server feature. Although the speed can't fully keep up, you can observe a different speed selection. Now, instead of starting with one character, it begins with several.

analysis.insight_summary: Users note that the ticker timer setting for message display functions properly in simulation and on the integrated display of the basis module, but does not work on the operator device, where the interval remains fixed at 10 seconds. This inconsistency makes the operator device appear less flexible and possibly buggy. There is evident frustration about repeated issues and insufficient testing of the product line.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect the ticker timer setting to behave consistently across simulation, integrated display, and operator device hardware, with user-defined changes applied correctly on all devices.
